title: Your Pension Depends on Kids You Did Not Have
excerpt: Pay-as-you-go pensions need a growing base of future workers to fund a shrinking one of retirees. Not having kids is free, and someone else pays twice.
content_html:
Pay-as-you-go pensions need a growing base of future workers to fund a shrinking one of retirees. Not having kids is free, and someone else pays twice.

A pay-as-you-go pension is a claim on other people's children. It only works if enough of them exist, and it pays out the same whether you helped make them or not.

Start with the arithmetic, because it is not a matter of opinion. The ratio of retirees to workers has been climbing for decades and keeps climbing.

  • The OECD's old-age dependency ratio, people 65 and over per 100 people aged 20 to 64, has more than doubled since 1960 and is still rising
  • The share of the OECD population aged 65 and over went from 18 percent in 2022 to a projected 30 percent by 2060
  • The US Social Security retirement trust fund is projected to run dry in 2033, after which incoming payroll taxes cover only 77 percent of scheduled benefits

A pay-as-you-go system does not hold your money in an account with your name on it. It pays retirees out of the wages of whoever happens to be working the year they retire. Children are the actual capital stock of the system, not the contributions on a payslip. That makes the decision to have them, or not, an economic decision with consequences for people other than the parents.

Alessandro Cigno and Martin Werding worked out the mechanics of this in their book on children and pensions, and the case comes down to two plain facts about anyone who opts out of raising children.

  • They spend less over their own lifetime, since raising a child to adulthood costs a working income's worth of money and years
  • They still collect a full pension, funded by the payroll taxes of other people's children once those children are working adults

That is a free ride, not a private choice with no side effects. It is also not a hypothetical someone dreamed up for a paper. Germany's constitutional court ruled in 2001 that charging parents and childless contributors the identical rate for long-term care insurance was unconstitutional, since parents already bear the economic cost of raising the next generation of contributors. The legislature responded with a surcharge on childless contributors, 0.25 percentage points of gross income from 2005, raised to 0.35 points in 2022. In April 2022 the court went further still and ruled that even a flat surcharge was not enough, because the cost of raising three children is not the cost of raising one. The same court accepted that ordinary pension insurance already compensates parents adequately, through credited child-rearing years built into the benefit formula. Germany's own pension system, in other words, already runs a small transfer from the childless to parents, because the courts made it.

Pensions Buy Fewer Babies. Cutting Them Costs Votes. made the fertility case for reforming these systems. The demographic and fairness case stands on its own and does not depend on anyone changing their family plans in response. The dependency ratio keeps rising regardless of what any single household decides, and the free ride does not correct itself. Someone has to be the last generation asked to fund a promise made when the ratio still worked.

Before you treat a pension check as money you paid in and are owed back, check who actually funds it. A pay-as-you-go system pays out of current workers' wages. If you did not help produce any of those workers, someone else's children just did.

content_html_zh:
现收现付养老金需要不断增长的未来工人基础来为不断减少的退休人员提供资金。 不生孩子是免费的，别人要付出双倍的代价。

现收现付养老金是对其他人子女的索取权。 只有当它们存在足够多的时候它才有效，而且无论你是否帮助制作它们，它的回报都是一样的。

从算术开始，因为这不是意见问题。 几十年来，退休人员与工人的比例一直在上升，而且还在不断上升。

  • 经合组织的老年抚养比，即每 100 名 20 至 64 岁人口中 65 岁及以上人口的比率，自 1960 年以来已增加一倍多，并且仍在上升
  • 经合组织国家 65 岁及以上人口的比例从 2022 年的 18% 预计到 2060 年将达到 30%
  • 美国社会保障退休信托基金预计将在 2033 年耗尽，此后缴纳的工资税仅能覆盖预定福利的 77%

现收现付系统不会将您的钱存入有您名字的账户中。 它从退休当年正在工作的人的工资中支付退休人员。 儿童是系统的实际资本存量，而不是工资单上的缴款。 这使得决定是否生孩子成为一个经济决定，会对父母以外的人产生影响。

亚历山德罗·西格诺（Alessandro Cigno）和马丁·韦尔丁（Martin Werding）在他们关于儿童和养老金的书中阐述了这一机制，这个案例归结为关于任何选择不抚养孩子的人的两个简单事实。

  • 他们一生中的支出较少，因为抚养孩子到成年需要花费相当于工作收入的金钱和岁月
  • 他们仍然领取全额养老金，资金来源于其他人的孩子成年后的工资税

这是搭便车，不是私人选择，没有任何副作用。 这也不是某人为一篇论文设想的假设。 德国宪法法院于2001年裁定，向父母和无子女缴费者收取相同费率的长期护理保险是违宪的，因为父母已经承担了抚养下一代缴费者的经济成本。 作为回应，立法机关对无子女缴款人征收附加费，从 2005 年起占总收入的 0.25 个百分点，到 2022 年提高到 0.35 个百分点。 2022年4月，法院更进一步裁定，即使是固定附加费也不够，因为抚养三个孩子的成本不是抚养一个孩子的成本。 该法院承认，普通养老保险已经通过将子女抚养年数纳入福利公式，为父母提供了充分的补偿。 换句话说，德国自己的养老金制度已经从无子女的人手中小额转移给父母，因为法院是这样做的。

养老金买更少的婴儿。 削减它们需要花费选票。 提出了改革这些制度的生育理由。 人口和公平案例是独立的，并不依赖于任何人改变他们的家庭计划作为回应。 无论单个家庭做出什么决定，抚养比都会不断上升，而且搭便车现象不会自行纠正。 必须有人是最后一代被要求为该比率仍然有效时做出的承诺提供资金的人。

在您将养老金支票视为您已缴纳并被欠款的款项之前，请检查实际资助者是谁。 现收现付制度从当前工人的工资中支付。 如果你没有帮助培养这些工人，那么别人的孩子就会帮助培养这些工人。
